summary: DEC-0399 restore-board is not executable: remove-verdict leaves done/AISDLC-1179.1.completed.json by design and no CLI removes it, so the AC-4 remainder runs under AISDLC-1236 and AISDLC-1179.1 is superseded (dispatchable: false)

options.description: AC-4 runs as AISDLC-1236; 1179.1 superseded; 1179 closes when 1236 lands. Applied.
Delete done/AISDLC-1179.1.completed.json by hand and re-enqueue 1179.1; loosens board integrity, not class (a).

body: DEC-0399 chose restore-board (remove the false success verdict, re-enqueue 1179.1). remove-verdict ran 2026-11-08 07:0xZ but board.ts writes a completion marker behind a success verdict so the id stays taken, and no sanctioned subcommand removes the marker (AISDLC-1235 AC-5 adds one). A hand deletion of a board file would loosen board integrity, so the planner applied the second DEC-0399 option instead: the AC-4 remainder is refiled as AISDLC-1236 and AISDLC-1179.1 becomes dispatchable: false, superseded. Same mechanism as the 2026-11-07 ruling that created 1179.1. Class (a): tightens nothing, loosens nothing, reversible by refiling.
